verdict.rationale: The only evidence is a single release-manifest entry for a Fedora WSL image. It shows a Fedora build packaged to run as a Linux environment inside Windows via WSL, but it is a Beta 'Base' artifact listed by filename only. Boxes runs VMs on a Fedora host, which is the opposite direction, and the Toolbox container subvariant is not shown running on a foreign host OS, so neither is credited. Missing for 10: documentation of installing and using Fedora under WSL or other host OSes, evidence of a stable (non-beta) release, any description of the terminal or dev-tooling experience in that environment, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run a full Linux terminal environment inside another host OS for development and tooling
